description: Search the App Store and Google Play for apps by name in one storefront country (for Google Play the country later picks the review languages). Returns each match's app_id per store, developer, rating and store links. Use it for apps that are not in rivioo_my_apps; ask the user for the country if it is unknown. Omit store to search both stores. Free; delivers no reviews.

country.description: Two-letter storefront country to search, such as us or gb.

store.description: 'ios' for the App Store or 'android' for Google Play.

name: rivioo_find_app

charged_this_call.description: Reviews this call read for the first time in 30 days.

free_rereads_this_call.description: Reviews this call returned free because they were first read in the last 30 days.

remaining.description: Reviews this account can still read for the first time this month.

title: Find an app
